metadata.question: Did the smoke plumes originating from fires in Siskiyou County on August 18, 2021, travel northward for at least 20 miles?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use Sentinel-5P TROPOMI UV Aerosol Index for 2021-08-18 over Siskiyou County (CA) and a 200 km buffer AOI to the north. If no images, try S5P NRT and/or widen to ±1 day. 
2. Masking strategy: Mask low-quality pixels using qa_value >= 0.75. Detect smoke proxy where absorbing_aerosol_index >= threshold (start 1.0, fallback 0.5).
3. Logic: If collections empty -> C1. If, after QA and thresholding, either source (county) or north plume has zero pixels -> try threshold fallback; if still zero -> C2. Compute northward distance using max latitude of plume north vs mean latitude of source; if null/NaN -> C3. If distance >= 32.2 km -> A, else B.

```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function getInfoAsync(obj) {
  return await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    obj.getInfo((v) => resolve(v), (e) => reject(e));
  });
}

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const counties = ee.FeatureCollection('TIGER/2018/Counties');
    const siskiyou = counties
      .filter(ee.Filter.and(ee.Filter.eq('NAME', 'Siskiyou'), ee.Filter.eq('STATEFP', '06')))
      .first();
    const countyGeom = ee.Feature(siskiyou).geometry();
    const aoi = countyGeom.buffer(200000); // 200 km buffer
    const start = '2021-08-18';
    const end = '2021-08-19';
    const expandedStart = '2021-08-17';
    const expandedEnd = '2021-08-20';

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check
    let dsId = 'COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3/UVAI';
    let col = ee.ImageCollection(dsId).filterDate(start, end).filterBounds(aoi);
    let size = await getInfoAsync(col.size());
    let dateWin = `${start} to ${end}`;
    let srcTag = 'S5P OFFL';
    if (size === 0) {
      // Try NRT
      dsId = 'COPERNICUS/S5P/NRTI/L3/UVAI';
      srcTag = 'S5P NRT';
      col = ee.ImageCollection(dsId).filterDate(start, end).filterBounds(aoi);
      size = await getInfoAsync(col.size());
    }
    if (size === 0) {
      // Widen date range
      dsId = 'COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3/UVAI';
      srcTag = 'S5P OFFL (±1d)';
      col = ee.ImageCollection(dsId).filterDate(expandedStart, expandedEnd).filterBounds(aoi);
      size = await getInfoAsync(col.size());
      dateWin = `${expandedStart} to ${expandedEnd}`;
      if (size === 0) {
        // Try NRT with widened dates
        dsId = 'COPERNICUS/S5P/NRTI/L3/UVAI';
        srcTag = 'S5P NRT (±1d)';
        col = ee.ImageCollection(dsId).filterDate(expandedStart, expandedEnd).filterBounds(aoi);
        size = await getInfoAsync(col.size());
      }
    }
    if (size === 0) {
      console.log(`S5P Images: 0`);
      console.log(`Date window: ${dateWin}`);
      console.log(`AOI: Siskiyou +200km`);
      console.log('C1: Empty Collection');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }
    const img = col.median();
    const qa = img.select('qa_value');
    const aiRaw = img.select('absorbing_aerosol_index');
    const ai = aiRaw.updateMask(qa.gte(0.75));

    // Valid QA pixels in AOI
    const validCount = await getInfoAsync(ai.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: aoi,
      scale: 7000,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('absorbing_aerosol_index'));
    if (!validCount || validCount === 0) {
      console.log(`S5P Images: ${size} (${srcTag})`);
      console.log(`Date window: ${dateWin}`);
      console.log(`Valid QA px (AOI): 0`);
      console.log('C2: No Valid Pixels');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // Define north area (north of county centroid latitude)
    const centLat = ee.Number(ee.Geometry.Point(countyGeom.centroid(1000).coordinates()).coordinates().get(1));
    const northRect = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-180, centLat, 180, 90], null, false);
    const northArea = aoi.intersection(northRect, 1);

    // Thresholding with fallback
    let thr = 1.0;
    function countsAndDist(threshold) {
      const aiThr = ai.updateMask(ai.gte(threshold));
      const countSource = ee.Number(aiThr.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: countyGeom,
        scale: 7000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('absorbing_aerosol_index'));
      const countNorth = ee.Number(aiThr.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: northArea,
        scale: 7000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('absorbing_aerosol_index'));
      const latImg = ee.Image.pixelLonLat().select('latitude');
      const srcMeanLat = ee.Number(latImg.updateMask(aiThr).reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry: countyGeom,
        scale: 7000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('latitude'));
      const northMaxLat = ee.Number(latImg.updateMask(aiThr).reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.max(),
        geometry: northArea,
        scale: 7000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('latitude'));
      const dKm = ee.Number(northMaxLat).subtract(srcMeanLat).max(0).multiply(111.32);
      return { countSource, countNorth, srcMeanLat, northMaxLat, dKm };
    }

    let res = countsAndDist(thr);
    let sourceCount = await getInfoAsync(res.countSource);
    let northCount = await getInfoAsync(res.countNorth);
    let dKm = await getInfoAsync(res.dKm);

    let usedFallback = false;
    if ((!sourceCount || sourceCount === 0) || (!northCount || northCount === 0)) {
      // Fallback threshold
      thr = 0.5;
      res = countsAndDist(thr);
      sourceCount = await getInfoAsync(res.countSource);
      northCount = await getInfoAsync(res.countNorth);
      dKm = await getInfoAsync(res.dKm);
      usedFallback = true;
    }

    console.log(`S5P Images: ${size} (${srcTag})`);
    console.log(`Date window: ${dateWin}`);
    console.log(`Valid QA px (AOI): ${validCount}`);
    console.log(`AI threshold: ${thr}${usedFallback ? ' (fallback)' : ''}`);
    console.log(`Source smoke px (county): ${sourceCount || 0}`);
    console.log(`North smoke px: ${northCount || 0}`);

    if ((!sourceCount || sourceCount === 0) || (!northCount || northCount === 0)) {
      console.log('C2: After QA/threshold, zero px in source or north region');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    if (dKm === null || isNaN(dKm)) {
      console.log('C3: Calculation Failure (distance is null/NaN)');
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    const dKmRounded = Math.round(dKm * 10) / 10;
    console.log(`Max northward distance (km): ${dKmRounded}`);

    const thresholdMiles = 20.0;
    const thresholdKm = 32.1869;
    const answer = dKm >= thresholdKm ? 'A: Yes' : 'B: No';
    console.log(answer);
  } catch (err) {
    console.log('D: Dataset or processing error');
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
